brief.note: Indexes at records — these are single-name earnings reactions, not a selloff. Prices are Tuesday's close.

candidates.name: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals
candidates.business: RNA-silencing drugs for rare inherited and heart diseases
candidates.cause: Cut 2026 product revenue guidance by $200m as second-line demand for Amvuttra normalised after a pent-up launch surge.
candidates.right: Amvuttra demand has to settle at a level the new guidance already assumes
candidates.wrong: Normalisation keeps going, and the whole growth rate resets lower again

candidates.name: Sportradar Group
candidates.business: Sells live sports data and odds to betting operators
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue rose 19% to EUR378m but missed forecasts, and guidance was cut on delayed prediction-market deals and US softness.
candidates.right: The delayed prediction-market contracts have to actually land, not disappear
candidates.wrong: Still 26x earnings after the fall, so a second miss hurts twice

candidates.name: Aptiv PLC
candidates.business: Wiring, connectors and electronics that make vehicles work
candidates.cause: Beat on earnings but trimmed 2026 revenue guidance by $300m — about 2% — on China weakness and delayed programme launches.
candidates.right: China has to stop deteriorating, and the delayed launches have to arrive
candidates.wrong: China is a structural loss rather than a delay, and the cuts keep coming

candidates.name: Bruker Corporation
candidates.business: Makes scientific instruments for labs — mass spectrometry, imaging
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue of $838m missed by under 2% and full-year guidance came in 1% light, despite an earnings beat and margins up 510bps.
candidates.right: Lab spending has to hold up, so a 2% miss stays a wobble not a trend
candidates.wrong: Academic and pharma budgets tighten further and instrument orders keep slipping

candidates.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
candidates.cause: Pulled jalapenos from Minnesota restaurants after 110 people fell ill in a salmonella outbreak traced to one supplier lot.
candidates.right: It has to stay one supplier lot in one state, and traffic has to come back
candidates.wrong: It spreads beyond Minnesota and becomes 2015 again, which took years to undo
